title: Bay View holiday guide: markets, lights and Santa
dek: Christmas on KK, the tree lighting, pop-up markets, heated cocktail huts and where to give, from Black Friday to New Year's Eve.
tease: Markets, lights and Santa, Nov. 27 to Dec. 31

image.alt: Christmas on KK 2026 flyer: Friday, Dec. 11, 5-9 p.m., with a list of participating businesses
image.credit: Bay View Community Center (@bayviewcentermke) on Instagram

intro:
Bay View does the holidays its own way: a stroll down KK instead of a big-box mall, Santa arriving by fire engine, and cocktails in heated huts on a patio. Here's what's on the neighborhood calendar between Black Friday and New Year's Eve, with a few worth-the-drive picks nearby.

Dates and times come from each organizer's own post or listing, linked below. Plans change, so check the link before you head out. New events land on our Events page every morning.

items.name: Christmas on KK
items.where: Shops and restaurants along Kinnickinnic Ave.
items.text: The neighborhood holiday stroll is back, benefiting the Bay View Community Center. Fourteen businesses had signed on as of Nov. 23, with crafts at Chippy's for a canned-food donation, a cocoa bar at Ela Mari, kids' crafts at Strange Scene and Santa at Tippecanoe Herbs.
items.source: Bay View Community Center on Facebook

items.name: Bay View's annual tree lighting with Santa
items.where: Immaculate Conception Church, 1023 E. Russell Ave. (west lot)
items.text: Carols and a sing-along, then Santa pulls up on a fire engine at 6:30 to light the tree. Chili, cocoa and cookie decorating follow indoors.

items.name: Santa Cycle Rampage
items.where: Starts at the Wisconsin Bike Fed, 187 E. Becher St.
items.text: Riders dressed as Santas, elves and reindeer take a festive group ride. It's beginner-friendly, but registration is required.

sections.heading: Markets and shopping
sections.intro: Gift shopping without leaving the neighborhood.

items.name: Plume Vintage Black Friday weekend sale
items.when: Fri. Nov. 27 to Sun. Nov. 29, from 10 am Friday
items.text: Three days of vintage markdowns, with the deepest cuts in the first and last hour on Black Friday.

items.name: Small Misery Business Saturday
items.text: An emo-themed pop-up market of local makers and artists for Small Business Saturday, from Graveyard Gallery and Superb Market.

items.name: Pop-up maker market and movie night
items.where: Avalon Atmospheric Theater, 2473 S. Kinnickinnic Ave.
items.text: Good Shit Video, Chippy's, Lion's Tooth and 4 of 4 Creative set up tables in the theater around a movie night. Times and tickets are on the Avalon's site.

items.name: Milwaukee Makers Marketplace
items.where: Hide House, 2625 S. Greeley St., Suite 135
items.text: Everything on the shelves is made by Milwaukee artists and makers: ceramics, candles, prints, jewelry and apparel. Read our spotlight for the backstory.

items.name: At Random's Magic Forest
items.text: The cocktail lounge turns its patio into a winter hideaway of heated huts and holiday lights. Book ahead; hut charges go on your tab. Kids are welcome until 8 pm, and it's 21+ after that.

items.name: The Elf pop-up at Lost Whale
items.text: The bar's Elf-themed holiday pop-up returns for its run through New Year's Eve.

items.name: Black Friday beer releases
items.where: Torzala Brewing, Lincoln Warehouse, 2018 S. 1st St.
items.text: Torzala opens early for its Black Friday bottle and can releases.

items.name: Rescue-dog giving tree at Mac's PetDepot
items.text: Take a paper ornament, buy the supply listed on the back and leave it at checkout for JRs Pups-n-stuff.

items.name: Food drives at Christmas on KK
items.text: Several Christmas on KK stops are collecting canned food and raising money for the Bay View Community Center.
items.source: Bay View Community Center on Facebook

items.name: City and county Holiday Drive
items.where: City Hall and other drop-off sites listed by the city
items.text: Non-perishable food, winter coats for kids, toys and toiletries for the Metcalfe Park People's Pantry.

sections.heading: Worth the drive
sections.intro: Not in Bay View, but close.

items.name: Milwaukee Holiday Lights Festival
items.text: Six weeks of light displays around downtown, just across the Hoan.

items.name: Milwaukee Makers Market holiday market
items.where: Discovery World Pavilion, 500 N. Harbor Dr.
items.text: The big pop-up version of the Hide House shop, with free admission. The organizer says dates can change.

outro: Hosting something in Bay View this season? Send it through our tip form and we'll add it.
